rows.details: Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research (JNCASR)
Centre of Excellence (COE) at JNCASR "National Centre for Carbon Capture and Utilization (NCCCU) DST-JNCASR/SCP/4696B"
Temporary position in the sponsored project
Rs. 46,800 plus applicable HRA (Provisional) / Rs. 58,000 plus applicable HRA
New Chemistry Unit, JNCASR, Jakkur, Bengaluru

content_sections.heading: About JNCASR
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Nehru Centre For Advanced Scientific Research is located at Jakkur P.O., Bengaluru - 560064, Karnataka. Its letterhead describes it as an autonomous institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, and an Institution Deemed-to-be-University. This position belongs to the NCCCU project led by Principal Investigator Prof. Sebastian C. Peter and Co-Principal Investigator Prof. M. Eswaramoorthy of the New Chemistry Unit.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or related areas. Candidates who have submitted thesis but have not completed the defence can also apply. Desirable qualification: Experience in thermochemical CO2 capture and utilization. Age limit: The maximum age limit is 35 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice prints two pay levels for the single position: Research Associate (Provisional): Remuneration of Rs. 46,800 plus applicable HRA Research Associate: Remuneration of Rs. 58,000 plus applicable HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the Application form in Template, which the notice says is available on the website. Fill in the application form. Attach copies of original testimonials in support of educational qualification, age, experience, publication, etc. Attach a brief resume. Send the application to [email protected] latest by December 03, 2026. Duly filled in Application form in Template Copies of original testimonials supporting educational qualification, age, experience and publication Brief resume No Objection Certificate from the employer, for those in employment (applies only to outside candidates)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview. Candidates will be selected based on their performance in the interview by a selection committee. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Those in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer. This applies only to outside candidates. Contact numbers printed on the notice: +91 80 2208 2749 / 2755 / 2750.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JNCASR Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. NCU-EMR-185)?
faq.answer: There is 1 temporary Research Associate position in the NCCCU project at the New Chemistry Unit, JNCASR.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to [email protected] latest by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or related areas. Experience in thermochemical CO2 capture and utilization is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates who have submitted their PhD thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who have submitted thesis but have not completed the defence can also apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 46,800 plus applicable HRA for Research Associate (Provisional) and Rs. 58,000 plus applicable HRA for Research Associate.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. Both pay levels are printed as the remuneration "plus applicable HRA".

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for JNCASR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the duly filled Application form in Template, copies of testimonials for qualification, age, experience and publications, and a brief resume to [email protected] by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the JNCASR Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview, and the selection committee will select candidates based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Do employed candidates need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Those in employment must submit a No Objection Certificate from the employer; this applies only to outside candidates.
